```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, dampack
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

# Load PSA caches for all three models
psa_files <- list(
  A = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_joint.rds"),
  B = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_focused.rds"),
  C = here("data", "tidy", "psa_obj_separate.rds")
)

psa_objs <- list()
for (model_name in names(psa_files)) {
  if (file.exists(psa_files[[model_name]])) {
    psa_objs[[model_name]] <- readRDS(psa_files[[model_name]])
    cat("Loaded PSA cache for Model", model_name, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r calculate-ceacs, include=FALSE}
wtp_range <- seq(0, 150000, by = 2000)

model_labels <- c(
  A = "Model A (Joint)",
  B = "Model B (Focused)",
  C = "Model C (Separate)"
)

ceac_data <- data.frame()

for (model_name in names(psa_objs)) {
  ceac_obj <- tryCatch(
    dampack::ceac(wtp = wtp_range, psa = psa_objs[[model_name]]),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(ceac_obj)) {
    ceac_obj$Model <- model_labels[model_name]
    ceac_data <- rbind(ceac_data, ceac_obj)
  }
}

cat("CEAC data rows:", nrow(ceac_data), "\n")
```

```{r create-ceac-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  strategy_labels <- c(
    "control" = "Control (FLOX only)",
    "crp" = "CRP Strategy",
    "tlr" = "TLR Strategy",
    "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF Strategy"
  )

  ceac_data$Strategy <- factor(
    ceac_data$Strategy,
    levels = names(strategy_labels),
    labels = strategy_labels
  )

  ceac_data$Model <- factor(ceac_data$Model, levels = model_labels)

  strategy_colors <- c(
    "Control (FLOX only)" = "gray50",
    "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR Strategy" = "#009E73",
    "TMB/BRAF Strategy" = "#0072B2"
  )

  p_ceac <- ggplot(ceac_data, aes(x = WTP, y = Proportion, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~Model, ncol = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 51000, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100000, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_currency(
        prefix = "\u20AC", scale = 0.001, suffix = "K", big.mark = ","
      ),
      breaks = seq(0, 150000, by = 25000)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = "Strategy") +
    labs(
      x = "Willingness-to-Pay Threshold (EUR/QALY)",
      y = "Probability of Being Cost-Effective"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  print(p_ceac)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure_s4.png"),
    plot = p_ceac,
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure_s4.png"), "\n")
}
```
